detail.title: Intex IT-1712 W SMPS & USB Computer Cabinet
detail.overview: The Intex IT-1712 W is a versatile and budget-friendly computer cabinet designed to meet the essential needs of PC builders. Equipped with an integrated SMPS (Switch Mode Power Supply) and front USB port, this cabinet provides reliable performance for home and office use. Its compact design supports Micro ATX and Mini ITX motherboards, making it ideal for space-saving desktop setups. With multiple expansion and internal slots, it ensures enough room for both HDDs and SSDs, supporting a dual-drive configuration for enhanced storage. An 80 mm cooling fan ensures optimal airflow, while the front MIC port enhances accessibility for audio peripherals.
